name: instanode CI — failure rate spike (P2)
description: P2 (observability) when the CI failure rate across all repos exceeds 40% over 1h — a broken shared dependency (sibling-repo checkout, a flaky service container, an infra outage) or a bad merge reding many PRs at once. Reads the InstantCITestRun{result} events emitted by the .github/actions/nr-ci-event composite action on every gated job (api/worker/instanode-web). FACET by repo so the responder sees which repo's CI is red. Triage: open the 'instanode — CI health' dashboard; the InstantCITestFailure event for the same commit_sha carries failed_step + log_url. This is P2 not P1: a CI red blocks merges but does not break prod (the e2e-prod / pr-smoke alerts cover prod). The emit no-ops without the NR secret, so this never fires before secret provisioning. Source: .github/actions/nr-ci-event/action.yml in each repo.

nrql.query: SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE result = 'fail') FROM InstantCITestRun FACET repo
